sub_issue.title: [ops-resilience 01/14] Close the sync server first in semprec-api's graceful shutdown
[ops-resilience 02/14] Widen the service units' restart limits to survive a multi-minute outage
[ops-resilience 03/14] Complete a superseded job's failed run instead of dead-lettering it
[ops-resilience 04/14] Fail the doc sweeps' jobs when every doc failed and log per-doc failures structurally
[ops-resilience 05/14] Install and enable the Caddy site from provision.sh
[ops-resilience 06/14] Settle push deliveries as not-configured instead of retrying the fanout ten times
[ops-resilience 07/14] Listen for idle pool client errors and bound connection and statement time
[ops-resilience 08/14] Route Inbox ticks to their serial queue in production and run other jobs concurrently
[ops-resilience 09/14] Prune permanently failed queue rows daily and scope the alert to fresh unlocked rows
[ops-resilience 10/14] Beat a mailsync:<id> process heartbeat per hosted mailbox
[ops-resilience 11/14] Install an nftables ruleset that owns its own table and leaves Docker's alone
[ops-resilience 12/14] Make /opt/semprec/shared readable by the semprec user for the APNs key and timer scripts
[ops-resilience 13/14] Bound semprec-transcribe's stop and resume an interrupted transcription from its checkpoint
[ops-resilience 14/14] Remove MinIO from Compose and pass Postgres only its own variables
